meta.title: About Puntr | Sports intelligence, on the record
meta.description: Puntr is a South African, community-first sports intelligence platform: discover fixtures, analyse verified data, publish locked predictions, compare with the community and collect PuntPoints. 18+.
meta.ogTitle: About Puntr | Sports knowledge, on the record

hero.body: Puntr is a <1>community-first sports intelligence platform</1> for South African fans and tipsters. Discover fixtures, analyse checked data, publish your picks before kick-off and build a public record that shows the full picture, wins and losses together. Our <1>Puntr Football Intelligence Engine (PFIE)</1> checks the data behind it all.

why.p1: Sport is full of opinions. Puntr gives those opinions a consistent way to be tested: every pick is timestamped before kick-off, locked and graded against the confirmed result.
why.p2: A winning screenshot tells only part of the story. Puntr keeps wins and losses together, with performance context, so the community can judge a record on its merits.

data.title: Checked data
data.body: Fixtures, results and tables confirmed by PFIE before they appear.

community.title: Community
community.body: See what other predictors think, then make your own call.

ai.title: AI-assisted, rules-checked
ai.body: AI helps read the sources. Fixed rules and independent sources decide what is true.

recognition.title: Recognition
recognition.body: Be known for your knowledge, with a record to prove it.

journey.body: Four steps, from the first fixture you check to a record you can stand behind.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Your home base: upcoming fixtures, the teams you follow and your next best move, in one place.

analyse.title: Analyse
analyse.body: League tables, last-five form and head-to-head history for every covered match.

predict.title: Predict
predict.body: Publish your pick before kick-off. It is timestamped, locked and can never be edited.

prove.title: Prove it
prove.body: Picks are graded automatically. Compare with the community, climb the leaderboards and collect PuntPoints.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To build a <1>community-first sports platform</1> where knowledge is tested openly, performance is transparent and genuine contribution gets recognised.
mission.vision: To become a trusted home for sports intelligence in South Africa, and then across Africa, with every pick on the record.

community.title: Community First
community.body: Build together. Learn together. Be accountable together.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Clear information. Honest interactions. Every pick stays on the record.

responsible.title: Responsible Gambling
responsible.body: Promote informed, measured and responsible choices. 18+ only.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.body: Keep improving the technology behind the experience.

recognition.title: Fair Recognition
recognition.body: Recognise genuine knowledge and contribution. Money never buys rank.

evidence.title: Evidence Over Noise
evidence.body: Back predictions with a record, not noise.

ecosystem.body: Everything connects: the fixtures you discover feed the analysis, your picks feed your record, and your record feeds the community.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: A personal home base with fixtures, followed teams and a league rail.

teams.title: Team directory
teams.body: Search every covered team and follow up to 50 of them.

tables.title: League tables
tables.body: Verified standings with last-five form, built for any screen.

analysis.title: Match analysis
analysis.body: Form, head-to-head history and table context on each fixture.

record.title: Locked predictions
record.body: Timestamped before kick-off, graded automatically, never edited.

duels.title: Community Duels
duels.body: Head-to-head calls with other members and a Duel leaderboard.

board.title: Leaderboards
board.body: Ranked on results and sample size. PuntPoints never affect rank.

practice.title: Practice Mode
practice.body: A fictional league that plays out in minutes, to learn the ropes risk-free.

points.title: PuntPoints
points.body: Collected for activity, redeemed for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks. No cash value.

pro.title: Puntr Pro
pro.body: Deeper analytics and tools for members who want more.

pfie.title: Data you can check, not just trust.
pfie.body: PFIE is the engine behind Puntr's fixtures, results and league tables. AI never decides what is true: it helps read the sources, then fixed rules and independent sources settle the facts.

collect.title: Collect
collect.body: Fixtures, results and tables are read from the league's own site and other reputable sources.

check.title: Check
check.body: Deterministic rules validate every record, and independent sources must agree before it counts.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Only verified data reaches the site. If a refresh fails, the table is flagged or held back.

sports.body: We start with football and add sports only once their data and grading are ready. Until then, no page claims coverage of them.
sports.heading: Sports coverage
sports.footballBody: {{count}} launch leagues, with more already being read by PFIE for after launch.

tech.title3: Foundation, Strategic Partnership Network And Next-Generation Technology…
tech.body: A dependable platform, sports data and carefully selected services support the experience. We will be clear about what is live, what is in development and what is planned.

fits.c1: Puntr web app, installable on your phone
fits.i3: PFIE (fixtures, results and tables, checked against independent sources)

knowledge.body: Make your call, build a complete record and let your performance speak for itself.

recognised.title: Be recognised
recognised.body: Let your record do the talking.

knowledge.sample: Example names and numbers, for illustration only.

points.body: PuntPoints recognise eligible activity and community contribution. Collect them and redeem them for available vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks. Points have no cash value and never affect rankings.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.body: Be recognised for getting it right.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.body: Take part, contribute and build your reputation.

tipsters.title: Tipster Support
tipsters.body: From 1 December: verified members who win 10 picks in a row unlock Tipster Support, and other members can back them with PuntPoints to get their picks copied the moment they post. Open to everyone; Puntr Pro adds more. Points, not cash.

refer.title: Recurring commission on Puntr Pro referrals.
refer.body: Share Puntr with your sports community. When someone you refer becomes a paying Puntr Pro subscriber, you can earn 10–30% recurring commission under the programme terms. Commission comes from Pro subscription revenue only, never from bets, deposits or winnings.

cta.body: Your next prediction is a chance to build a record. Make it count.

video.title: Watch the Puntr explainer
video.body: A short look at what Puntr is and where it is going.

launch.title: Official launch: 1 December 2026
launch.body: Founding Member registration is free. The Founding Member Annual Pass is {{pass}} once-off for 12 months of Puntr Pro, compared with {{annual}} at the standard rate of {{monthly}} per month. Membership activates on 1 December 2026 and does not renew automatically.
launch.note: Insights on Puntr are informational and do not guarantee outcomes. The Founding Member Annual Pass is a prepaid membership, not an investment or donation.

vision: To become a trusted home for sports intelligence in South Africa and, over time, across Africa, with every pick on the record.
